metadata.title: DUO icosahedral level 4 (N=5120 cells, ~700 km)
metadata.description: DUO triangular icosahedral mesh at subdivision level 4 (5120 triangular cells, 2562 vertices, 7680 edges). Quasi-uniform global sphere; constant valence 3. Generated by build_duo_grid via the builtin icosahedral loader; no file I/O required.
